requirements.label: explicit
requirements.statement: The hero shows an illustration at the right of the headline
requirements.condition: An illustration of about 520 x 400 px is visible at the right of the hero at 1440 px.

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.statement: The primary call-to-action button is 220 px wide
requirements.condition: The Start free button width is within tolerance of 220 px at 1440 px.

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.statement: The headline is the dominant text on the page
requirements.condition: The h1 font size is at least that of every other text element at 1440 px.

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.condition: The nav landmark holds exactly 4 links at 1440 px.

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.condition: The Sample Co. wordmark is visible in the navigation at 1440 px.

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.statement: The hero and the features section are 96 px apart
requirements.condition: The vertical gap from the hero to the features heading is within tolerance of 96 px.

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.statement: The call-to-action uses the design colour and the arrow icon
requirements.condition: The Start free button has the same colour as the design and an arrow icon, not a chevron.

check.question: Does the button match the design colour and use the same arrow icon?

requirements.label: explicit
requirements.statement: The page ends with a footer
requirements.condition: A footer with text is visible at the end of the page at 1440 px.

requirements.label: inferred
requirements.statement: Expected the mobile page to fit the screen without overlap (inferred)
requirements.condition: At 390 px there is no horizontal scroll and no overlapping or clipped text.

requirements.label: inferred
requirements.statement: Expected the primary action to stay visible on mobile (inferred)
requirements.condition: The Start free button is visible at 390 px.
